approach.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Kredik Shaw. The Hill of a Thousand Spires. Obligators walk the yard, and some of them are Seekers.
Keep your copper burning and stay off the ground. Meet me on the balcony.

inside.speaker: Kelsier
lines: From here we fight. Their armour is a gift: Push it and the man goes with it.

soothing.speaker: Vin
lines: Everything feels... heavy. Flat. Like the air is pressing the feeling out of me.

lines.text: Copper. Burn copper and it stops.

hut.speaker: Kelsier
lines: A hut. Here, in the heart of his palace. The Lord Ruler kept something here.
I will open it. Go ahead and look for anything he wrote.

bendal.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Inquisitor! Vin, you cannot fight him. Burn your atium, read him, take the book and RUN.

wound.speaker: Vin
lines: The axe... cold, so cold. Pewter. Keep the pewter burning. Run.

collapse.speaker: Sazed
lines: Child? Child! Lord Kelsier said... no matter. Into the carriage. Quickly now.
